tests.command: fixed-SHA byte-measure: 7605fa9 baseline vs b931be0 final path (reproduction commands listed in evidence)
tests.evidence: Actual reproducible measurement (PH-246, fixed SHAs; per-component bytes and the command list below): baseline 7605fa9 = manifest 663 + tasks.json 217565 + active handoff project/handoffs/PH-233.md 1510 + docs/delivery-status.md 61218 = 280956 bytes; final path b931be0 = orient 3423 + brief PH-232 1893 + docs/delivery-status.md 1996 + project/specs/PH-232.md 8448 = 15760 bytes; reduction 1 - 15760/280956 = 94.39% ≈ 94.4%. Reproduction: `git show 7605fa9:project/manifest.json | wc -c` (663); `git show 7605fa9:project/tasks.json | wc -c` (217565); `git show 7605fa9:project/handoffs/PH-233.md | wc -c` (1510); `git show 7605fa9:docs/delivery-status.md | wc -c` (61218); `rm -rf /tmp/ph237-measure && mkdir -p /tmp/ph237-measure && git archive b931be0 | tar -x -C /tmp/ph237-measure` then in that tree `python scripts/projectctl.py orient | wc -c` (3423), `python scripts/projectctl.py brief PH-232 | wc -c` (1893), `wc -c < docs/delivery-status.md` (1996), `wc -c < project/specs/PH-232.md` (8448); `python -c "print(round((1-15760/280956)*100,2))"` -> 94.39. The earlier non-reproducible byte-measure numbers are superseded; the archive PH-237 entry and verification calibration now carry the same 280956/15760/94.4% caliber.
